name: nord-vpn
tagline: This is an OpenVPN client docker container that uses recommended NordVPN server
description: This is an OpenVPN client docker container that uses recommended NordVPN server. It makes routing containers traffic through OpenVPN easy.

env.name: COUNTRY
env.label: Countries to connect to (see webpage readme)

env.name: GROUP
env.label: Group name filter to which to connect to

env.name: RANDOM_TOP
env.label: Range of servers to pick from the top

env.name: RECREATE_VPN_CRON
env.label: Define when to look again for new defined servers

env.name: CHECK_CONNECTION_URL
env.label: URL to check internet connection is working to

env.name: NETWORK
env.label: Subnet to define network access (read Local Network access to services connecting to the internet through the VPN readme to get the right subnet!)

env.name: OPENVPN_OPTS
env.label: Used to pass extra parameters to openvpn
